entries.title: Finished steps of a crewmate on another computer show their results sooner
entries.body: When a Claude crewmate runs on another of your computers, the Crewmate tab now shows a step's result once that computer records it, rather than showing the step as running until the crewmate's next message.
entries.noPicture: This fixes when a result appears in the Crewmate tab, which a still picture cannot show.
